title: The stability barrier of a class of Hermite-type discretizations of advection equations
summary: In this paper we fully categorize all hybrid-variable (HV) discretizations of linear advection equations according to their stability property and establish the stability barrier of these methods. In the HV discretization framework, we find numerical approximations to both cell-averaged solutions and nodal solutions and evolve them in time simultaneously.
